# Obsiddy-In Terminal

Obsiddy-In Terminal is a retrofuturistic amber-on-dark interface with IBM Plex Mono typography and a CRT scanline vignette. It carries warm dark and light palettes with amber accents across headings, tags, links and the graph. The recorded description pairs it with Obsiddy In for matching browser-to-vault visuals.

![Obsiddy-In Terminal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leonjacobs-collab/obsidian-terminal-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Obsiddy-In Terminal"
    author: "leonjacobs-collab"
    repo:   "leonjacobs-collab/obsidian-terminal-theme"
    slug:   "obsiddy-in-terminal"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/obsiddy-in-terminal"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/leonjacobs-collab/obsidian-terminal-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leonjacobs-collab/obsidian-terminal-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a retrofuturistic amber-on-dark interface with IBM Plex Mono typography and a CRT scanline vignette for warm, terminal-style visuals. Switch between warm dark and light palettes and get amber accents across headings, tags, links and graph. Pair with Obsiddy In for matching browser-to-vault visuals."
}
```
